[[File:Woolcob_helmet.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gazdo Woolcob's flight helmet]]
'''Gazdo Woolcob''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]], and flew as [[Gold Seven]] with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]].<ref name="Grounded" /> He participated in an [[Battle of Scarif|attack]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] to help steal the plans for a [[superweapon]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> He was later [[Death|killed]] in the [[Battle of Yavin]], when his [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] was destroyed by flak from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star's]] [[Turbolaser|anti-ship battery]] fire. Around the time of his death, he had accrued 4,816 flight hours and four confirmed kills.<ref name="Grounded" />
